prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent static boss sprite for a Maple-inspired 2D RPG lab.
Primary request: pixel-art Algorithm of Semi-Intransient Matrix of Overseer Network, faithful to supplied visual references.
Input images: image1 final full-body arrangement; image2 official final design sheet, use its front/side/back structural details and not disabled black states.
Subject/composition: one complete frontal floating mechanical assembly in the arrangement of image1. Sandstone tan geometric body with dark navy inset faces, pale blue-lavender light. Center: open upright triangular outer frame around an inverted triangular inner face with three smaller engraved triangular panels and a small glowing hexagonal core; two dark upper spikes. Detached upper left and upper right units each have a tan pointed disk with a pale blue center and a long dark tapered conical tip extending upward/outward. Detached long pointed segmented sandstone arrow units extend left and right horizontally. Below center are two tan curved prong pieces containing round blue-white lights, a slim central dangling diamond-point ornament, and two separated small blue hexagonal rosette units. Maintain transparent gaps between these separate floating modules. Do not merge them into wings or humanoid arms.
Style: crisp chunky pixel art with dark colored outlines and limited tan/navy/blue palette. Keep triangular openings, blue core, long points and broad silhouette legible at 160 pixels tall then 80. Simplify engraved linework into a few large strokes rather than noisy tiny symbols. Entire assembly visible with generous margin, all tips intact.
Constraints: actual transparent background, including gaps. One static sprite only; no orbit motion, lightning, lasers, attack effects, extra shards, dust, ground, shadow, text, logos, UI or multiple versions. Light is confined to the component surfaces, no diffuse glow haze.
